chunks: Ḥumayd ibn Shuʿayb, al-Shuʿaybī, al-Hamdānī, Kufan. His ḥadīth is recognized sometimes, and other times rejected. Most of [his ḥadīths] are confused (dependent upon weak sources) from what was narrated from Jābir. His affair is obscure.

key_terms.أَمْرُهُ مُظْلِمٌ: His affair/status is obscure or unclear, indicating uncertainty about his reliability
key_terms.تَخْلِيطٌ: Confusion or mixing of weak and strong narrations, a specific defect in hadith transmission
key_terms.حُمَيْدُ بْنُ شُعَيْبٍ: Ḥumayd ibn Shuʿayb, the narrator being assessed

ai.seo_question: What is the reliability status of the narrator Humayd ibn Shu'ayb in Shia hadith sciences?
ai.summary: This entry provides a biographical assessment of the narrator Ḥumayd ibn Shuʿayb from the Kufan school. It notes that his narrations are inconsistent, often containing confusion (takhlīṭ) derived from Jābir, and that his overall status in hadith sciences is considered obscure or unclear.
